---
title: "Tutorial"
description: "A linear SCNSim micro-course from primitive authoring to Direct, optimization, reusable composition, and pump-off HB."
anchor-sections: false
---

Follow the course in order. Each page answers one user question with one focused
operation and inspection. If an API has not been taught, the course does not
use it.

::: {.callout-note title="Stabilized dev4 scope" appearance="simple"}
The Library, Composite, and recursive-expansion behavior taught in Lessons
6–8 is `STABILIZED`. Lessons 1–5 remain the `CONVERGING` dev3 execution
candidate; Lessons 9–13 remain `CONVERGING` and explicit fail-fast APIs until
their named V1 slices land.
:::
